now.what: When the data was built, the commit, the open Day, the next step and the open pull requests.
now.graph: the header and Where we are

rows.what: One row per merge: what the specs name and the code has, the measures counted at that commit.

files.what: The files trajectory() counted the names in, at the last merge.
files.graph: not drawn; no view reads it

days.what: Each Day of the plan: its spec, status, criteria, tracks, Notes and Defect lines.

origin_lines.what: The number of lines the first spec had.
origin_lines.graph: not drawn; no view reads it

order.what: The Days in the plan's order.

out_of_order.what: The Days the plan's order does not follow.
out_of_order.graph: not drawn; no view reads it

removals.what: Criteria or Days a later merge removed.
removals.graph: not drawn; no view reads it

hand_offs.what: What a Day's Notes or a test's comment defers to a later Day.
hand_offs.graph: not drawn: the views read it, and the cell lists the hand-offs addressed to its Day

look_ahead.what: How far to the next stop: the hand-off ledger and what is pending.

criteria_index.what: Every criterion with its Day, tag, tests, evidence and state.
criteria_index.graph: Graphs 3 to 5, 6, 7's One Day, 12 and the gene

attention.what: The criteria the index flags, each with its reason.
attention.graph: not drawn: the views read it (Needs attention)

test_inventory.what: The tests in tests/ and scripts/ at the last merge, by file.
test_inventory.graph: not drawn: the views read it

defect_recurrence.what: Defects of a kind seen again on a later Day.
defect_recurrence.graph: not drawn: the views read it

fixes.what: specs/fixes.json: each fix to the process and the pull request that made it.
fixes.graph: not drawn: the views read it (the cell and graph 1's row of old problems back)

user_stories.what: Each pull request's user story and the abilities named in plan.md.

plan.what: plan.md's commitments and the criteria whose Plan: lines serve each.

gene.what: Each commitment of plan.md by the state of the criteria that serve it.

gate_report.what: Each gate's catches and the guards' refusals.
gate_report.graph: not drawn: the views read it (Graph 7)

defect_counts.what: The Defect lines counted by Day and by tag.
defect_counts.graph: not drawn: the cell's view reads the rater's agreement

never_found.what: The known faults each checking agent's cases name that it never found.
never_found.graph: not drawn: the views read it (Graph 7)

other_groups.what: The names counted in no group of the measures.
other_groups.graph: not drawn; no view reads it

vocab_size.what: The number of backticked names the specs hold.
vocab_size.graph: not drawn; no view reads it

tokens.what: Each session's tokens and dollars, from scripts/token-usage.py.
tokens.graph: not drawn: the views read it (Graphs 7 and 8), and the cell its heat and the Day of each date

refusals.what: The guards' refusals, from the dashboard-data branch.

verification.what: Each pull request's checks on GitHub.

evidence_checks.what: docs/dashboard/evidence-checks.json: the replay's report on the closes.
evidence_checks.graph: not drawn; no view reads it

replay.what: scripts/replay-history.py's re-check of every criterion at every merge.
replay.graph: not drawn: the views read it (Graph 6)

conclusion.what: The lab notebook's conclusion, by Day.
conclusion.graph: not drawn; no view reads it

yardsticks.what: Each yardstick's value by Day and its verdict.

clock.what: When each pull request opened, its checks ran and it merged.

counted.what: When the dashboard-data branch was last counted.

driver_runs.what: The driver's runs, steps and parks, from the dashboard-data branch.

data.what: Which files the dashboard-data branch gave, and which it lacked.

meta.what: Caveats, provenance, the project's name and address, the phases, stops and where rows.

merge_graph.what: Graph 6's merges against the spec, a stripe per criterion.

score.what: The quality score: one number out of 100, by Day and by ability.
score.graph: the header and Where we are

where_ring.what: The plan as one turn of the cell cycle, a checkpoint at each stop.
where_ring.graph: Where we are and the gene

reading.what: The plan being read, merge by merge.

gel.what: The yardsticks drawn as a gel.

protein.what: The abilities as proteins, each promise a cell on its chain.

proofreading.what: The checking as error correction, gate by gate.

budget.what: The dollars as an energy budget, a bead per two dollars.

rings.what: The files as growth rings, a band per kind.

actogram.what: The clock as an actogram, a lane per actor.

reflex.what: The driver's steps, each replayed as a cell.

learning.what: Repeats per Day and each fix's before and after.
learning.graph: The cell's loop station and graph 1's row of old problems back

one_day.what: One Day step by step, each defect at the step it was caught.

rewrites.what: Replaced promises joined to what replaced them.

cell.what: Each checking agent's challenge test from its case set, and the check each fix is drawn beside.

needs_attention.what: What needs attention, by one rule.

file_map.what: Every tracked file at its station.
